claims.claim: Pydantic v2's extra="forbid" configuration raises a validation error when model validation receives fields not declared by the model.

sources.title: Configuration | Pydantic Docs — extra
sources.quote: Providing extra data is not permitted, and a ValidationError will be raised

newer_practice.summary: Pydantic 2.12 added per-validation-call extra overrides. This supplements model configuration; it does not change this step when the effective setting remains 'forbid'.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. The claim correctly describes validation with effective extra='forbid'; an explicit per-call override can select different behavior.

claims.claim: Pydantic 2.13.5's model_copy(update=...) copies the supplied update values without validating them.

sources.title: Pydantic v2.13.5 — BaseModel.model_copy source and documentation
sources.quote: the data is not validated before creating the new model.

sources.title: BaseModel | Pydantic Docs — model_copy
sources.quote: no validation is performed on updated values.

newer_practice.summary: Pydantic 2.14.0 was released, and current documentation still describes update values as unvalidated. Its availability does not invalidate the explicit 2.13.5 claim or require an upgrade for this step.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. Retain the version-specific warning that model_copy(update=...) is not a validation boundary.

claims.claim: SQLite permits only one simultaneous write transaction, and BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY if another connection already has an active write transaction.

sources.title: Transaction — SQLite
sources.quote: only one simultaneous write transaction. … start a new write immediately

sources.title: Result and Error Codes — SQLITE_BUSY
sources.quote: The BEGIN IMMEDIATE command might itself return SQLITE_BUSY

newer_practice.summary: SQLite 3.50.0 introduced sqlite3_setlk_timeout() for separately configuring blocking-lock timeouts on supporting builds. This optional facility changes waiting behavior, not the single-writer rule or possibility of SQLITE_BUSY; no step change is established.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. Retain the claim, scoped to competing connections accessing the same database; BEGIN IMMEDIATE does not guarantee immediate acquisition.

claims.claim: SQLite trigger execution of RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the current query and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.

sources.title: CREATE TRIGGER — The RAISE() function
sources.quote: current query terminates. … SQLITE_CONSTRAINT … the specified error message.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. The current official trigger documentation directly supports the stated behavior; no relevant superseding practice was identified.

claims.claim: Python 3.12's hashlib provides sha256, whose hexdigest method returns a hexadecimal representation of the digest.

sources.title: hashlib — Secure hashes and message digests — Python 3.12 documentation
sources.quote: hashlib.sha256([data, ]*, usedforsecurity=True) … hash.hexdigest() … containing only hexadecimal digits.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. Python 3.12 documentation confirms both the constructor and hexadecimal output; no relevant replacement for this API usage was identified.

claims.claim: RFC 8785 orders JSON object property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 encoding of the resulting canonical serialization.

sources.title: RFC 8785: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), Sections 3.2.3–3.2.4
sources.quote: arrays of UTF-16 … code units. … MUST be encoded in UTF-8.

newer_practice.summary: The individual Internet-Draft on SCITT canonicalization declarations references RFC 8785 directly for its JCS construction. It is a proposal, not a replacement standard, and does not change this step's sorting or encoding requirements.

claims.recommended_action: No change required. Retain the distinction between UTF-16 property-name ordering and UTF-8 output encoding; this finding does not establish implementation conformance.
